desc: Implement single-cost bottom-up DP (v=current majority, f=min flips to flip); leaves (v=bit, f=1), internal node takes sum of two smallest child costs to reach target t=1-v_new; output f[root].
Process level-by-level reducing size by factor 3; numpy vectorized primary path plus pure-Python fallback; handle both "010011101" and space-separated digit input.
Run on Sample 1 (N=2, "010011101" -> 1) and Sample 2 (N=1, "000" -> 2); both passed.
Brute-force verify correctness of the combine rule on many small random inputs (N=1,2, and sample N=3 cases); no mismatches found.
